settings.seoDescription: Working alongside communities across Northeast Nigeria to strengthen resilience, promote peace and create pathways to a more dignified future.

home.heroIntro: Working alongside communities across Northeast Nigeria to strengthen resilience, promote peace and create pathways to a more dignified future.
home.location: Communities across Borno, Adamawa and Yobe
home.aboutIntro: The Justice Development and Peace Initiative (JDPI) Maiduguri is the development and humanitarian organisation of the Catholic Diocese of Maiduguri, working with vulnerable communities across Borno, Adamawa and Yobe States. We accompany people and communities to build resilient lives, promote peace, uphold human dignity and create opportunities for a more just and peaceful society.

aboutImage.alt: Volunteers distributing aid at an outdoor donation center, promoting social impact and diversity

home.partnersIntro: Our work is made possible through trusted partnerships.
home.supportIntro: Your generosity helps us work alongside vulnerable communities to strengthen livelihoods, improve access to essential services, promote peace and restore dignity.
